bubblewrap_everywhere: implemented, preferred when its probe passes, and so far verified on NO host. Where it cannot start, the landlock backend is used only after its own probe passes; where neither passes, SHD admission refuses with REFUSED_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE. No host setting was weakened and no privileged helper was installed.
difference_local_vs_hosted: none observed for the landlock backend (same denials on aarch64 and x86-64). The hosted package job does not run the real-source journey (private sources); the executor does.
other_platforms: macOS, Windows, kernels without Landlock or working bubblewrap: SHD admission refuses with REFUSED_ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE; every other function works
what_it_is_not: process confinement, not a container; no PID/mount namespace on the landlock backend; no defence against a kernel vulnerability or the same OS user outside the worker; no independent security review
not_advice: Research and education only. Not investment advice.
